comment: Dr. Ashworth has been around Richmond forever and hasn't changed his ways. His class lectures are based on a few sheets and the material doesn't change. The grade is made up of 2 exams and a group paper/project. If you do well on those it's an easy A/A-, but don't expect much help outside of class.
Very serious about everything. He makes things boring

Nice guy but truly painful to sit through a class. Would serve yourself better to read the textbook the 2 classes before the tests for vocabulary. Retained almost nothing from lectures or teaching materials on the board aside from life in the ol days.

I didn't retain a single thing from his lectures because he rambles for half of each class about nothing. I reached out to him for help several times throughout the semester and only received one reply. What's the point of teaching if you're not going to teach or help your students when they ask for help outside the classroom?

His head is stuck in the past. Widely regarded as ignorant and unable to speak about minorities, women or disabled people in a decent way-  he refers to them as if they were the "other," instead of equal people.   As noted below, his tests require pointless memorization. The lectures are painful because he sounds so dumb. Should not be at UR.
I received all A's all semester but wound up with a B, without an explanation even though I asked multiple times.  Sexist and disgusting.  DO NOT TAKE!

Dr. Ashworth is not that terrible. The class is fairly easy, two tests and one project. Plus he's a pretty lenient grader. This is the kinda of class you can cram for a few nights before the test and never have to do anything else the entire semester. But it is true he's rather boring.

he is the most incompetent teacher ever and should not be teaching. he babbles about nonsense the entire class occasionally putting dated slides up on the overhead. his tests are absolutely impossible-writing down his lists verbatim and knowing obscure facts from a book you'll never discuss. prepare to suffer through, learn nothing, and get a B.

Forget the humor, take this class for the pure hilarity of Ashworth's self-loathing. He has so many ridiculously funning sayings and quips about himself and his family you'll find yourself laughing your @ss off. On multiple occasions he referred to his life as a "miserable existance." The class is boring, but then again, any OB class would be.
He is really boring, and his tests are decently hard.  I would definetly not take him, plus you don't learn anything
